contours.name: seat_stay
contours.role: paired structural member; broad molded lateral faces, straight long upper run and localized shoulder into link
contours.section: rounded rectangle, flat lateral middle face with softly chamfered perimeter, not ellipse
contours.occlusion: rear axle and inner edge partially obscured by cassette/brake; use official highlight0/2 and manual31 as topology

contours.name: chain_stay
contours.role: paired lower swingarm; broad lower edge and shaped rise at front pivot; keep independent from front triangle
contours.section: flattened carbon face with protected inner upper shelf, separate round mechanical pivots
contours.occlusion: main pivot front rise and BB adjacency partly hidden by crank; contour is proposal supported by opposite/rear photo

contours.name: dropout_connection
contours.role: integrated reinforced seatstay end and separate horst end below/front; axle insert not enormous thin detached plate
notes: Do not merge seatstay and chainstay across their pivot mechanically.
UDH hanger drive side only; brake base other side.
Actual rear axle insert is elongated with distinct face, manual16–18.

contours.name: seat_tube_front_triangle
contours.role: front triangle molded spine with broad side face; not cylindrical straight tube down to BB
contours.occlusion: BB/lower spine partially hidden by crank; merge smoothly into main front triangle side face; no exact carbon layup claim

contours.name: flip_link
contours.role: paired solid rocker, flat broad face and rounded chamfers, asymmetric settings; no triangular hollow rocker
notes: Use existing bores centers only after registration audit.
Bolt recesses need integral widened ends and darker central circular heads, not oversized exposed flat metal washers.
Link thickness and three dimensional lateral taper are inferred.

contours.name: lower_shock_support
contours.role: MOVING lower-swingarm forward clevis/extension, integrated with chain_stay body around main pivot; not fixed seat spine
notes: CORRECTED after adversarial topology review: upper shock mount fixed, lower eye must move with the lower swingarm.
Manual p31 depicts chainstay assembly independent of front triangle; opposite rear photo shows forked curved lower clevis and perspective overlap with fixed seat spine.
Union this polygon with chain_stay around shared main-pivot region; do not weld either cheek into fixed BB or seat spine.
Some linkage interior surfaces are hidden by spring; exact depth/clearance is inferred, but classification as moving body is required.

topology_corrections: Replace tubular surface sections with molded broad flat faces. Increasing radial thickness alone is insufficient.
Upper rear bridge immediately behind seat spine is broad carbon band with smooth end integration; not hollow round tube.
Keep real wheel clearance and opposing structural members. Do not close central wheel opening with mirrored plates.
Brake uses non-drive postmount base with two bolts and sculpted support; two unrelated thin pegs omit visible base.
ILA rear axle insert and horst pivot must remain visibly separate.
Main pivot959.1,835.5 and moving lower shock eye1009.6,837.8 native remain different centers; lower clevis extends from lower swingarm across main-pivot area, not from fixed seat spine.
acceptance: Overlay lateral silhouette against photograph in actual image coordinates, checking outer and inner edges rather than only member centerlines.
Check opposite rear view shows flat face, bridge width and smooth member transitions.
Check saddle spine curvature and lower cheek against original references, then assembled shock orientation.
Ray clearance/anchors/tests establish functionality only; they do not certify resemblance or 100 percent dimensional accuracy.
uncertainty: All polygon points hand observed from published perspective photos, with hidden edges interpreted from manual and opposite photo. They are a reconstruction proposal, not CAD or exact metrology.

connections: Seat spine continues behind rocker into fixed BB outer housing.
Fixed main-pivot bearing support resides above BB; the lower-shock clevis overlaps in perspective but is a DIFFERENT moving body.
fixed_front_triangle.bottom_bracket: Fixed lower front-triangle body includes BB outer shell, but excludes the moving lower-shock clevis. Keep both BB bore and kinematic separation.
fixed_front_triangle.note: CORRECTION of prior audit: lower_shock_support is NOT fixed. Both shock ends fixed would prevent shock compression. The apparent seat-spine continuity is photographic overlap.

upper_rear_body.connection: One uninterrupted broad side face from front seatstay eye to rear axle/dropout; split only at the true Horst bearing where lower swingarm meets this body. Both sides joined by the upper bridge forward of tire.

lower_rear_body.connection: Lower swingarm extends from Horst pivot through main pivot into projecting curved triangular lower-shock clevis. Two side cheeks belong to same moving swingarm, separated by shock-width clearance and smoothly united around main-pivot area.
lower_rear_body.note: Main pivot is the shared rotary center with fixed seat spine; mesh surfaces on each body remain separated transversely. Do not union moving clevis or its triangular cheek with fixed BB/front frame.

rocker_body.connection: Independent asymmetric solid rocker halves and transverse axle hardware; at each end, bearing housing registers over corresponding pivot. No literal weld to main frame or stay.

topology.geometry_join_acceptance: Coplanar overlap is an offline boolean/outline union within a single solid body; remove interior caps and seams rather than simply rendering several extruded plates through one another. For different kinematic bodies keep real clearance and visual bearing contact.

seat_stay.face: Broad lateral flat surface with bevel3–5mm and softly rounded transverse back; face width varies with traced outer edges, not one radius.

dropout_connection.note: Unite with upper seatstay face. Last section axle opening sidewall at hub mating face requires validation against hub148mm; external thickness does not certify true frame spacing.

flip_link.note: Do not render uniform-depth cardboard plate; end bearing bosses broaden smoothly and front/rear faces softly chamfer.

bridge_proposals.name: upper_seatstay_bridge
bridge_proposals.section: Broad low carbon band/rounded rectangular arch with smooth roots joining inner faces of both seatstays. No hollow cylindrical sleeve and no detached straight rod.
bridge_proposals.clearance: Center stays forward of tire envelope. Both roots overlap their own seatstay solid, remove end caps inside union. Keep seat spine/frame mechanically separate.
bridge_proposals.source: Opposite rear view and exploded manual31 show joined upper stays; exact bridge section/depth inferred.

bridge_proposals.name: lower_swingarm_root_yoke
bridge_proposals.section: Sculpted forked yoke joining opposing lower arms and their forward shock clevis around main-pivot region. One moving body; no union with fixed BB/seat spine.
bridge_proposals.clearance: Passes near fixed frame with visible separation. Keep lower shock central slot, BB opening, and independent rotary bearing contact; do not create plate across shock shaft or BB.
bridge_proposals.source: Opposite photo/manual31 support joined lower swingarm; exact brace surface partly hidden and must be verified in integrated view.

topology_evidence_correction.prior_error: The v2 proposal misclassified lower_shock_support as fixed due to perspective overlap in side view. That recommendation is withdrawn.
observed: Upper shock lug lies on fixed down tube.
Opposite rear official image shows lower shock eye in a forked curved extension above the lower swingarm main pivot.
Exploded MK4 manual p31 separates lower swingarm with its projecting front geometry from the fixed BB/seat spine.
topology_evidence_correction.mechanical_inference: With fixed upper mount, lower mount must belong to a moving link. Shape and continuity at main-pivot region identify lower swingarm extension; making both eyes fixed would eliminate compression.
topology_evidence_correction.limitation: Video340/470 frames document upper FlipLink but do not by themselves establish full lower-swingarm motion. Do not cite those frames as direct kinematic proof.

photographic_boundary_audit.method: Read RGBA8 native official PNG directly; white carbon sample=minRGB>120, max-min<38, alpha>150. Vertical white runs at native x=round(normalized_x*2300/2048), then expressed in2048-normalized coordinates solely to match independent checks. No rendered-model sample influenced thresholds. Pixel membership includes perspective shading, and hardware/occlusion must be excluded by region.
